services.value: Provides drinking water testing services including residential private well testing and public water supplier testing, with analyses such as bacteriology, volatile organics analysis by GC/MS, metals, non-metals, and disinfection by-products. Also provides non-potable water testing for commercial/pharmaceutical manufacturing industries (PMI) analyses including EPA Method 1666 Revision A and EPA Method 524.2, and offers sample collection and expedited/one business day turnaround options.
